_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 ẸKA ỌJỌ:
• O bẹrẹ pẹlu {start_chips} chips
• Igi 52 kan (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• O ṣeré pẹlu dealer (ile)
• Lati ṣe ibatan, o ṣe ANTE ati BLIND bets, gba 2 hole cards, ṣe aṣẹ ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ lori PLAY bets, ṣaaju ki o ṣe afihan community cards ati ṣe atunṣe pẹlu dealer. Ojumo re ni lati ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ (nigba ti o ni ọwọ ṣe pẹṣẹ), nigba ti o ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ (nigba ti o ni ọwọ ti ko ṣe pẹṣẹ).
• Ọjọ naa pa lọgbo nigba ti o de 0 chips tabi lọwọ fun ibẹrẹ ọjọ (LOSS) tabi nigba ti o parí 1000 ọjọ pẹlu chips (WIN)

💰 ẸKA OWÓ:
• ANTE: Owó ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ fun ọjọ lobinrin: ${ante}
• BLIND: Owó ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ fun ọjọ lobinrin: ${ante}
• PLAY: Owó ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ nigba ti o ṣeré. Lati ṣe ibatan, o le ṣe aṣẹ kan pẹlu: (${ante4} nigba ti o ṣe ni PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} nigba ti o ṣe ni FLOP, tabi ${ante} nigba ti o ṣe ni RIVER. O tun le ṣe aṣẹ fold ni RIVER, ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ, ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ, ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ.

🎴 ẸKA KAADI:
• O gba 2 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ (kaadi rẹ)
• Dealer gba 2 kaadi ti ko ṣe pẹṣẹ (ti ko ṣe pẹṣẹ fun o)
• 5 community cards ṣe afihan ni ibẹrẹ
• Community cards ṣe afihan lati ṣe ibatan

🏆 ẸKA DEALER:
• Dealer ṣe pẹṣẹ lati ṣe pẹṣẹ pẹlu kaadi 2 ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ (2 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ), ṣaaju ki o ṣe afihan community cards.
• Ẹka dealer ṣe pẹṣẹ lori iranṣẹ owó, gẹgẹ bi a ṣe ṣe afihan lọwọ.

🎮 ẸKA ỌJỌ & AṢẸ:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Aṣẹ: [4x] (${ante4}) tabi [check]
  • [4x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${ante4}, ṣe afihan community cards 3 akọkọ
  • [check]: Ko ṣe owó miran, ṣe afihan community cards 3 akọkọ

📋 FLOP:
  • Nigba ti owó 4x ṣe pẹṣẹ: Ṣe aṣẹ [skip] ṣe pẹṣẹ (ṣe afihan community cards 2 ikẹhin)
  • Nigba ti ko ṣe owó 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) tabi [check]
  • [2x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${ante2}, ṣe afihan community cards 2 ikẹhin
  • [check]: Ko ṣe owó miran, ṣe afihan community cards 2 ikẹhin

📋 RIVER:
  • Nigba ti owó 4x tabi 2x ṣe pẹṣẹ: Ṣe aṣẹ [skip] ṣe pẹṣẹ (ṣe afihan ọjọ naa)
  • Nigba ti ko ṣe owó PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) tabi [fold]
  • [1x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${ante}, ṣe afihan ọjọ naa
  • [fold]: Ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ, ṣe owó ANTE ati BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Ṣe afihan kaadi gbogbo ati ṣe atunṣe
  • Ṣe aṣẹ 5 kaadi ṣe pẹṣẹ (2 kaadi rẹ + 5 community)
  • Ṣe owó lori aṣẹ payout

💎 ẸKA OWÓ PAYOUT:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ko ṣe pẹṣẹ: PUSH (owó ṣe pẹṣẹ)
  • Dealer ṣe pẹṣẹ ati o ṣe pẹṣẹ: 1:1 payout (owó + iranṣẹ)
  • Dealer ṣe pẹṣẹ ati o ko ṣe pẹṣẹ: Owó ṣe pẹṣẹ
  • Tie: PUSH (owó ṣe pẹṣẹ)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ko ṣe pẹṣẹ lori dealer qualification
  • O ṣe pẹṣẹ: Owó ṣe pẹṣẹ ati iranṣẹ miran lori aṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ
  • O ko ṣe pẹṣẹ: Owó ṣe pẹṣẹ
  • Tie: PUSH (owó ṣe pẹṣẹ)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ko ṣe iranṣẹ miran

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ko ṣe pẹṣẹ lori dealer qualification
  • Atunṣe pẹlu: Aṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ vs Aṣẹ dealer ṣe pẹṣẹ
  • O ṣe pẹṣẹ: 1:1 payout (owó + iranṣẹ)
  • O ko ṣe pẹṣẹ: Owó ṣe pẹṣẹ
  • Tie: PUSH (owó ṣe pẹṣẹ)

🎯 ẸKA KAADI POKER (Ṣe pẹṣẹ si Ṣe pẹṣẹ):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  4. Full House: 3 ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ + 2 ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  5. Flush: 5 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  6. Straight: 5 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  9. One Pair: 2 kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ
  10. High Card: Kaadi ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ

⌨️  AṢẸ COMMANDS:
• [4x] tabi [play bet 4x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*4}}
• [2x] tabi [play bet 2x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*2}}
• [1x] tabi [play bet 1x]: Ṣe owó PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*1}}
• [check] tabi [c]: Ṣe aṣẹ (ko ṣe owó miran)
• [fold] tabi [f]: Ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ (ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ)
• [skip] tabi [s]: Ṣe aṣẹ si ọjọ naa (nigba ti ko ṣe aṣẹ)

💡 ẸKA STRATEGY:
• Aṣẹ bẹrẹ ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ (pairs, high cards) ṣe pẹṣẹ 4x bets
• Ṣe aṣẹ dealer qualification - aṣẹ ti ko ṣe pẹṣẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ push nigba ti dealer ko ṣe pẹṣẹ
• BLIND bet ṣe pẹṣẹ pẹlu aṣẹ ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Ṣe aṣẹ rẹ ṣe pẹṣẹ! Nigba ti o de 0 tabi lọwọ, o ṣe pẹṣẹ.

⚠️  ẸKA IMPORTANT:
• ANTE ati BLIND bets ṣe pẹṣẹ fun ọjọ lobinrin
• PLAY bets ṣe pẹṣẹ ati ṣe aṣẹ
• Ṣe aṣẹ ti o ṣe pẹṣẹ, ṣe aṣẹ kan ni wakati.
